Yes, auth-service has one active alert:

- **AuthTokenLatencyHigh**: severity **critical**, active since 2026-10-24T13:12:00Z.

The service registry lists auth-service under the id `svc-auth` (owned by the identity team, repo `acme/auth-service`). My first lookup used the name "auth-service" and came back empty, so I found the alert by listing all alerts and matching that id.

The two other alerts in the system are for different services: CheckoutDeployFailed on svc-checkout (active) and PaymentsWorkerErrorRate on svc-payworker (resolved).
